description: This dataset compiles human observations of the moth species Haritalodes derogata, primarily sourced from iNaturalist. It includes 20 records spanning multiple countries such as New Zealand, Australia, India, and South Korea, with observations recorded between 2016 and 2025. Each entry provides precise taxonomic classification, geographic coordinates, and event dates, alongside metadata regarding the observers and data licenses. The semantic profile highlights that the data serves as a biodiversity resource, offering primary keys for unique occurrences and spatial details at the country and state levels. Researchers can utilize this collection to analyze the distribution patterns, seasonal activity, and potential spread of this species across different regions.
